rationale.edition: All three changed files are under web/src/ (web/src/components/alerts/ and web/src/utils/alerts/) — OSS frontend paths. No enterprise-owned locations (enterprise/, o2_enterprise/, src/enterprise/) appear in the file list, and there are no enterprise keywords (cipher/SSO/SAML/RBAC/SDR/logo-management) in the paths or symbols.
rationale.skip: No skip marker is present: trigger_comment.txt is empty and no tests-added label was passed. The change is user-facing — AlertGroupChart.vue gains a new error display — so it is not docs-only or CI-only.
rationale.e2e: The change adds a new user-facing state: when an alert's stream has been deleted, the alert group chart now renders a warning icon plus the backend error message (e.g. "Stream 'logs' of type 'logs' does not exist") instead of a blank 'chart unavailable' state. This is verifiable end-to-end by creating an alert, deleting its stream, and viewing the alert chart.
